سَعُوطٌ Medicine that is poured, (S, Mgh, Msb,) or introduced, (K,) into the nose; (S, Mgh, Msb, K;) [an errhine;] as also صَعُوطٌ; (Lh, K;) which is thought, by ISd, to be an instance of assimilation [like صِرَاطٌ for سِرَاطٌ] such as Sb mentions. (TA.) ―
-b2- Also Sweat. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
